title: Release gates
text: A release requires passing API contract tests, integration tests, and Playwright smoke tests. The golden dataset evaluation must pass all cases before deployment.
keywords: release releases gate gates deployment deploy requirements checks required tests

title: Synthetic test fixtures
text: Each test creates a synthetic customer with a unique test-run ID. Fixtures delete created records after the test, including when assertions fail. Never use production customer data.
keywords: fixture fixtures synthetic data customer customers cleanup records test tests isolation

title: Payment API retries
text: Retry payment requests only for HTTP 429 and 503, with at most three attempts and exponential backoff. Reuse the same idempotency key for every attempt.
keywords: payment payments api retry retries retried attempts backoff idempotency key 429 503

title: Order API contract
text: POST /orders returns HTTP 201 with order_id, status, and total_cents. The status is pending and total_cents is a non-negative integer. A missing customer_id returns HTTP 422.
keywords: order orders api contract post response returns fields status missing customer_id total_cents order_id 201 422

title: Incident ownership
text: The on-call QA lead triages a failed release gate. The owning engineer fixes the defect, and QA reruns the failed checks before approving the release.
keywords: incident incidents ownership owner owns triage triages failed failure release gate lead engineer qa

title: Evaluation policy
text: The synthetic golden dataset contains supported questions and unsupported questions. Every case checks answer status, expected citations, and required facts. Demo answers must match their cited excerpt exactly.
keywords: evaluation evaluate eval golden dataset questions supported unsupported policy checks citations facts answers
